connector.name: Datasieve
connector.registryDescription: On-chain watches, web-page monitors, dead-man switches, cron, and agent coordination, paid via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package datasieve-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gitwormq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DATASIEVE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
env.description: Path to a file holding a burner wallet key (0x…) with USDC on Base. Optional — free tools work without it.

env.name: DATASIEVE_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Default https://api.datasieve.xyz; sandbox https://staging.datasieve.xyz (Base Sepolia, faucet USDC).
